## Why this matters

Every post follows the same simple structure: a clear motivation, the key idea explained with intuition first and math second, a small code example where it helps, and practical takeaways you can apply right away.

> Good research writing makes the reader feel clever, not the author.

## Takeaways

- Start from intuition, then formalize.
- Show a minimal, runnable example.
- End with what to do next.
